responsibility: Implements the WPA-time IPA pass that plans code-layout-driven function cloning for improved locality in LTO partitioning. This file analyzes the callgraph after inlining, orders entry functions using IPA profile counts or static edge-frequency heuristics, builds locality partitions with size limits, and when hot call chains would otherwise span incompatible partitions, creates and tracks local clones and redirects callers so frequently related code can be placed together. It owns the pass entry point and partitioning/cloning policy, including partition membership bookkeeping on cgraph nodes, clone/original maps, and handling of associated inline clones, duplicate symbols, thunks, and aliases that must travel with a partition.
same_name_distinction: Defines the implementation of the locality-cloning pass itself: it owns the WPA pass entry point, ordering/partitioning algorithms, clone creation and caller redirection logic, and the definition of the global locality_partitions vector declared by the header.
